reviews.review:
Good game. Pick it up on a sale though. I played the campaign 2 times and it only took me 10 h with the cutscenes. So... yea.
Other than that it is really fun, controls well. Just as you would expect. A good old Secret Formula for a good game :)

Highly recommended third person shooter video game that blends action and brutal gameplay that can be quite immersive and interesting to those who wants to buy and play it, you can invite your friends in story mode campaign, operations or siege mode  to join to fight 2 enemy factions either the heretics or tyranids. Perhaps a little bit of both along the way. Space Marine 2 is a game that is worth playing for fun and become one of the Emperor's strongest soldiers to pave way order across the universe. Once you buy this game, there are no pay to wins for this type of game and you'd have to require skills to overcome challenges (unemployment behavior cough cough). Although there are some things to consider when playing the game in the long run. First it can be a long grind for new players in pve as it does not require pay to win mechanics to enjoy the game, that's what the DLC cosmetics are for, they are strictly only for appearances. Second, It can be repetitive, unlike Helldivers with its diverse builds and endless generated maps on planets, space marine 2 operations rely on its static maps and meta builds that prove to be repetitive for the gameplay experience. Last but not the least, it focuses on power fantasy with strong melee focus while it is not a bad thing, the game forces you to melee in any other circumstances.

Love this game, its super fun with friends and has a lot of joy behind it. BUT there are a lot of frame drops and bs mechanics that should be fixed. Why is it that when i activate a turret with as teach marine i get insta killed when im in my animation to activate it and same when it goes to a gun strike like genuinely its stupid. I still recommend this game its cool and fun but just fix these problems and it will be perfect.
